tasks.description: On perspectives.html and engagement.html, .nav-links (Work/Perspectives/Engagement/Contact) has flex-wrap:nowrap with no width constraint below the 640-700px breakpoint. The row's natural width (~398px) exceeds the padded content area (~378px), so it overflows past the intended 20px right padding and 'Contact' sits flush against the raw viewport edge.
tasks.note: Fixed 2026-08-27: added flex-wrap: wrap; row-gap: 12px to .nav-links inside each file's mobile media query, so the row wraps to a second line instead of overflowing. Verified locally at 418px width in both files before commit.
